attributes.name: Giant Chameleon
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, you gain the skill Stealth: Dexterity +2.

While displayed, you may evade monsters you encounter. 

While displayed, on any check during your first exploration, put this card on top of your deck to add 1d6, or 2d6 if you have a role card.
